active_theories.statement: At fixed step, symplectic Yoshida yields lower long-time Jacobi drift than RK4 on smooth L4 motion.
At these finite horizons RK4 error constants dominate; RK4 beats Yoshida despite not being symplectic.
Step size controls the dominant truncation error; halving h lowers drift before roundoff dominates.
